Our case against the LOEWENHEIMs is not based on their one-time membership of the Communist Party. It is based on their well-established connection with the Russian espionage system.

In spite of the favourable view taken by the Hurst Tribunal of the brothers we feel we must continue to press strongly for their continued internment. Would you please let us know your decision in the matter?

W.C. Edwards.
